asked.item: Does Blotato check the mailbox is real for a fake email like abc@abc.abc

verdict.reason: S18 and S97 state that Blotato checks only the address shape, not whether the mailbox exists, and a nonexistent address still passes.

steps.text: No, Blotato checks the shape of the address, not whether the mailbox exists.
A nonexistent address still passes the email gate.
